fields.label: How this page works
fields.message:
Where do I change things on the website?

Top bar & header button → tab Header & Top Bar
Email, phone, address, hours → tab Contact Info
Text under the footer logo, medical disclaimer, copyright → tab Footer: Text
Payment & shipping logos in footer → tab Footer: Logos
4 trust cards above the footer (inner pages) → tab Footer: Trust Cards
Product page texts (badge, free shipping, trust icons, specs labels, no-reviews) → tab Product Pages
Bank transfer / PayID / order email wording → tab Checkout & Emails
Footer link columns (Trending, Quick Links, Cities, Info) and the main menu → Appearance → Menus (not here)
Page content (hero, FAQs, product sections) → edit the page itself

After clicking Update, the site cache is cleared automatically, so changes show on the front end within seconds.

fields.label: Site Logo
fields.name: site_logo
fields.instructions: Main logo in the header (and the footer, unless a separate footer logo is set in Footer: Text).

fields.label: Top Bar: Left Text
fields.name: topbar_left
fields.instructions: Small text at the left of the dark bar above the header.

fields.label: Top Bar: Centre Text
fields.name: topbar_center
fields.instructions: Small text in the middle of the dark bar above the header.

fields.label: Header Phone Button: Text
fields.name: whatsapp_button_text
fields.instructions: Text on the phone button in the header (e.g. 0488 841 833).

fields.label: Header Phone Button: Link
fields.name: whatsapp_button_url
fields.instructions: Link behind the header phone button (e.g. tel:0488841833). Leave empty to use the phone number from Contact Info.

fields.label: Support Email
fields.name: support_email
fields.instructions: Shown in the footer, the Support banner and on the contact page.

fields.label: Phone / WhatsApp Number
fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.instructions: Used for the footer "Chat Live" WhatsApp button and the phone links on contact, FAQ and delivery sections (e.g. 0488 841 833).

fields.label: Address
fields.name: location_text
fields.instructions: Shown in the footer contact block (e.g. 50 Holt Street, Surry Hills, 2010).

fields.label: Working Days
fields.name: working_days
fields.instructions: Shown in the footer contact block (e.g. Monday to Sunday).

fields.label: Office Hours
fields.name: office_hours
fields.instructions: Shown in the footer contact block (e.g. 24/7).

fields.label: Footer Contact Heading
fields.name: footer_contact_heading
fields.instructions: Heading above the address, WhatsApp and email in the footer (e.g. Get in Touch with Us).

fields.label: Support Banner Image
fields.name: support_cta_image
fields.instructions: Photo in the "Need help?" Support banner shown above the footer on the homepage.

fields.label: Footer Logo
fields.name: footer_logo
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty to reuse the Site Logo.

fields.label: Footer Description
fields.name: footer_description
fields.instructions: The paragraph directly under the logo in the footer.
fields.default_value: Waklert Australia provides clear information about a focused range of armodafinil products, ordering and delivery options.

fields.label: Medical Disclaimer
fields.name: disclaimer_en
fields.instructions: The "Medical Website Disclaimer:" paragraph under the footer description. Leave empty to hide it.
fields.default_value: This website provides general information only and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified health professional.

fields.label: Footer Pill 1 (Security)
fields.name: ssl_text
fields.instructions: Small green/blue pill under the disclaimer. Leave empty to hide.

fields.label: Footer Pill 2 (Dispatch)
fields.name: dispatch_text
fields.instructions: Small amber pill under the disclaimer. Leave empty to hide.

fields.label: Footer Pill 3 (Checkout)
fields.name: checkout_text
fields.instructions: Small green pill under the disclaimer. Leave empty to hide.

fields.label: Copyright Line
fields.name: copyright_text
fields.instructions: Bottom bar of the footer. Leave empty for the automatic "© year Site name" line.

fields.label: Payments Heading
fields.name: footer_payments_heading
fields.instructions: Heading above the payment logos in the footer.

fields.label: Payment Accepted Logos
fields.name: footer_payment_images
fields.instructions: Upload accepted payment logos (e.g. Commonwealth Bank, Osko, PayID). If left empty, this section will disappear.

fields.label: Shipping Heading
fields.name: footer_shipping_heading
fields.instructions: Heading above the shipping partner logos in the footer.

fields.label: Shipping Partner Logos
fields.name: footer_shipping_images
fields.instructions: Upload shipping partner logos (e.g. Australia Post). If left empty, this section will disappear.

fields.label: Enable Pre-Footer Trust Badges (Inner Pages)
fields.name: pre_footer_badges_enabled
fields.instructions: Toggle the 4 trust badge cards displayed above the footer on all inner pages.
fields.message: Display trust badge cards on inner pages

fields.label: Pre-Footer Trust Badges (Inner Pages)
fields.name: pre_footer_badges
fields.instructions: Edit the trust badge cards shown before the footer across all inner pages.

sub_fields.label: Custom Icon (Image/SVG)
sub_fields.name: custom_icon
sub_fields.instructions: Used only if Icon Style is set to Custom

fields.label: What is this tab?
fields.message: Fixed texts shown on every product page (for example /product/waklert-150/). Per-product details such as price, description and spec values are edited on the product itself in Products.

fields.label: 1. Badge & Free Shipping (near price / Add to Cart)
Featured Product Badge
fields.name: best_seller_label
fields.instructions: Badge on products ticked as Featured in WooCommerce (e.g. Best Seller). A custom badge set on the product wins over this.

fields.label: Free Shipping Message
fields.name: free_shipping_message
fields.instructions: Start of the free-shipping line on the product page. The amount below is added after it.

fields.label: Free Shipping Amount
fields.name: free_shipping_threshold
fields.instructions: Added after the message, e.g. "Free shipping on orders above $299 AUD".

fields.label: Trust Icon 1: Dispatch
fields.name: product_trust_dispatch
fields.instructions: Text next to the first small icon under Add to Cart.

fields.label: Trust Icon 2: Checkout
fields.name: product_trust_checkout
fields.instructions: Text next to the second small icon under Add to Cart.

fields.label: Trust Icon 3: Quality
fields.name: product_trust_quality
fields.instructions: Text next to the third small icon under Add to Cart.

fields.label: 3. Product Specs Table (lower on the page)
Specs Table Heading
fields.name: product_specs_heading
fields.instructions: Heading above the specs table.

fields.label: Row Name: Active Ingredient

fields.instructions: Left-hand row name only. The value comes from each product.

fields.label: Row Name: Indication

fields.label: Row Name: Strength

fields.instructions: Left-hand row name only. The value comes from each product.

fields.label: Row Name: Packaging

fields.label: "No Reviews" Text
fields.name: product_no_reviews_text
fields.instructions: Shown in the product reviews area, on shop product cards and in the catalog comparison when a product has no reviews.

fields.label: What is this tab?
fields.message: Fixed texts on the product cards shown on the Shop page (/shop/). The Shop page banner, SEO text and FAQs are edited in Pages → Shop → Page Modules. The "Best Seller" badge text is in the Product Pages tab.

fields.label: Buy Button Text
fields.name: shop_card_button_text
fields.instructions: Button at the bottom of every product card (opens the product page).

fields.label: Out of Stock Text
fields.name: shop_card_out_of_stock_label
fields.instructions: Shown on the badge and in place of the button when a product is sold out.

fields.label: In Stock Badge
fields.name: shop_card_in_stock_label
fields.instructions: Green badge on the top left of the card.

fields.label: Read More Link
fields.name: shop_card_read_more_label
fields.instructions: Link shown under long product descriptions.

fields.label: Price per Tablet: Word Before
fields.name: shop_card_unit_prefix
fields.instructions: Shows as "From $1.50/tab". This is the word before the price.

fields.label: Price per Tablet: Word After
fields.name: shop_card_unit_suffix
fields.instructions: This is the part after the price, e.g. /tab.

fields.label: Delivery Label
fields.name: shop_card_delivery_label
fields.instructions: Small truck label next to the price.

fields.label: PayID Number
fields.name: payid_number
fields.instructions: PayID phone number or identifier displayed on the thank you page (e.g. 0402 222 605).

fields.label: Transfer Reference / Description Warning Callout
fields.name: checkout_bacs_warning
fields.instructions: Dark blue callout text shown under PayID instructions.
fields.default_value: * Use the below BSB & account details to make the transfer. Simply mention your order number in the comment section. DO NOT reference anything related to medicine or website name. Just mention your order number.

fields.label: Payment Done Notice
fields.name: checkout_receipt_notice
fields.instructions: Instruction notice below the bank cards (use {email} as placeholder for the contact email).
fields.default_value: * Once your payment is done, just send the transaction copy to {email} and we'll ship your order immediately.

fields.label: Shipping Notice / Note
fields.name: checkout_shipping_note
fields.instructions: Estimated delivery timeline note shown above the order details table.
fields.default_value: The average shipping time is 10 - 15 days. Please note that delivery may take up to 30 days from the date of dispatch due to potential disruptions in postal services caused by weather issues or natural disaster.

fields.label: Order Confirmation Email - Intro Message
fields.name: email_on_hold_intro
fields.instructions: Intro paragraph shown after 'Hi [Customer Name],' in order confirmation emails.
fields.default_value: We've received your order and it's currently on hold until we can confirm your payment has been processed.

fields.label: Order Confirmation Email - Payment Instruction
fields.name: email_on_hold_instruction
fields.instructions: Payment instruction paragraph in order confirmation emails.
fields.default_value: Please complete your payment using EFT or PayID below with your order number and we will send the product immediately and also send you an Australian Post tracking number.

fields.label: Order Confirmation Email - Transfer Warning Note
fields.name: email_on_hold_warning
fields.instructions: Warning note in order confirmation emails (DO NOT, WAKLERT, Armodafinil are styled automatically).
fields.default_value: Please DO NOT mention WAKLERT or Armodafinil on your bank transfer description.
